description: Check whether a bank paid the APY it disclosed, in two recompute stages: first recompute the period's interest from daily balances under the caller's declared day-count convention, compounding, and rate terms, diffed against the core's reported accruals with a MATCHES, DIVERGES, or INDETERMINATE verdict (ART-661), then recompute the APY earned from a caller-supplied interest figure and the average daily balance and compare it with the disclosed APY inside a caller-declared accuracy band (ART-663), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Day-count convention, compounding, and every rate term are caller-declared inputs; a divergence is an arithmetic finding, never a determination that interest was miscalculated. Not legal advice and not tax advice.
name: apy-earned-check

steps.handoff: Recomputes the period's interest from daily balances under the caller's declared day-count convention, compounding, and rate terms; the recomputation is diffed against the core's reported accruals, with verdict MATCHES, DIVERGES, or INDETERMINATE

Recomputes the APY earned from a caller-supplied interest figure and the average daily balance and compares it with the disclosed APY inside the caller's declared accuracy band, with verdict MATCHES, DIVERGES, or INDETERMINATE
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: APY Earned Check
